insight: Founded in April 2023 by ex-Microsoft researchers; Tencent-backed and reported in Feb 2026 to be seeking a Hong Kong IPO.
name: StepFun
tagline: StepFun's multimodal assistant and Step-model API platform.
description: The chat assistant and developer platform of StepFun, the Shanghai AI lab behind the Step model family. The assistant at stepfun.ai bundles web search, knowledge-base Q&A, image generation, and Step-Audio speech tools, while the open platform at platform.stepfun.ai serves Step language, audio, and image-edit models over an international API.

modelSupport.notes: StepFun's own Step family; Step-3.5-Flash ships open weights under Apache 2.0.

edge: Multimodal breadth is the differentiator — language, audio, image, and video models from one lab, pushed into cars and phones via device partnerships.
pros: Audio and image models on one API
cons: English UX less polished than rivals

references.title: China's Overlooked AI Model Makers: Xiaomi, Meituan, and StepFun
